first_stage: Aggregate-only discovery of test changes embedded in original SWE-bench training patch fields; do not display task IDs, descriptions, paths, solution/test code or individual row associations.
reason: Dedicated test columns are empty; original human training patches may nevertheless contain test changes. Potential test-file detection is availability evidence, not an executable or passing benchmark label.
exclusions: Preserve Gate24 repository exclusions and all consumed/frozen task/source families. Do not repurpose official test rows as development.
followup_if_available: Freeze a metadata-only prospective task selection and split production/test patch materialization by machine without exposing reference code to an actor. Require original/gold executable controls and explicit environment/source provenance before any actor score.
otherwise: Continue ordered retrieval development on legitimate development data and reserve a prospectively frozen final test. Do not invent patch resolution or commercial superiority from navigation metrics.

new_source.download_contract: Verify pinned LFS hashes on all training shards. Inspect schema and aggregate dedicated test/image/eval field availability only before metadata-only prospective selection. Synthetic tasks are legitimate development inputs but cannot be labeled human issues or used to claim the official human SWE-bench score.
new_source.new_exclusion: oauthlib/oauthlib and benchmark forks after search-result solution exposure; preserve Gate24 exclusions.

limits: No production/model/default changes, paid APIs, new training or public release in the discovery stage. Separate feedback/evidence and full task costs; retain failures.
